risk_summary: The excerpt provides substantial quantified operating and liquidity data, but includes extensive boilerplate forward-looking disclaimers and limited detail on the recoverability of a large related-party receivable. Risk is elevated due to continuing losses, only $72,907 of cash, reliance on customer deposits and accrued liabilities for operating cash flow, and an explicit going-concern qualification. Reported net income is largely driven by a one-time gain on disposal rather than continuing operations.
